diagnosis: Customer requests billing contact change and refund from unverified personal email while traveling, matching identity_unverified category. Cannot confirm they are authorized account owner; requires human verification per kb-0018. Refund request also cannot be evaluated until identity is confirmed.
reply: Thank you for reaching out. To protect your account, we're unable to process billing contact changes or financial requests without verifying your identity as a named account owner on record. Our team will need to complete this verification before we can proceed with your request.
